svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Executions of the Relacy models
svg.text: One bar per model and search (library counter; the ThreadSanitizer counter gives the same numbers). Logarithmic axis.
A full search ends when every schedule of the restricted reads-from relation was run; the others stop at their bound or count.
control: the weak outcome is found
